/: public landing page, read before sign-in; the assistant is a signed-in feature
/pricing: public marketing page, read before sign-in
/transparency: public read-only report; the period buttons only change which half year is shown
/api-status: a public health readout of the API; nothing to operate
/unauthorized: an access-denied notice with a link back
/login: sign-in: the person types their own credentials; the assistant never fills a password
/register: sign-up: the person types their own credentials; the assistant never fills a password
/forgot-password: password reset request, typed by the person
/reset-password: password reset from an emailed token, typed by the person
/auth/oauth-callback: OAuth handshake; renders a spinner and redirects
/auth/sso-complete: SSO handshake; renders a spinner and redirects
/auth/verify-email: email verification from an emailed token
/demo: hands off to the demo session and redirects to /dashboard/founder
/dashboard: redirects to the signed-in role's dashboard
/test-onboarding: a development harness for the onboarding flow, not a product page
/themes/alliance: a theme showcase, not a product page
/t/[slug]: a tenant's public page, read without an account
/p/[username]: a person's public page, read without an account
/pitch/[id]: a shared pitch, read without an account
/share/[token]: a shared research board, read-only by its link
/org/[slug]: an organisation's public page, read without an account
/ai: the assistant itself: the workspace the conversation runs in
/ai/capabilities: generated from the action declarations the assistant uses; reading it changes nothing
/dashboard/founder: an overview that links to the pages that act; its figures come from the entity reads (milestones, messages, connections, events)
/dashboard/incubator: an overview that links to /org/* and /tenant/*, where the controls live
/dashboard/investor: an overview that links to the pipeline, watchlist and portfolio, where the deal commands live
/dashboard/mentor: an overview that links to /mentor/*, where the mentee and session controls live
/dashboard/provider: an overview that links to /provider/*, where the service and inquiry controls live
/tenant/dashboard: an overview that links to the /tenant/* pages that act
/profile/edit: a form: update_profile proposes the fields and the person saves
/milestones/new: a form: create_milestone proposes it and the person confirms
/events/create: a form: create_event proposes it and the person confirms
/projects/create: a form: draft_project fills its fields from the conversation and the person walks the steps and presses Create; no create-project write is declared
/mentor/profile: a form for the mentor listing, filled and saved by the person
/provider/profile: a form for the provider listing, filled and saved by the person
/invite: an invite form: the person names who to invite; the assistant does not send email on its own
/org/settings: organisation settings form, saved by an organisation admin
/tenant/settings: tenant settings form, saved by a tenant admin
/tenant/branding: tenant branding form (colours, logo), saved by a tenant admin
/tenant/billing: billing: seats, the payment portal and the billing contact stay with the person; the assistant does not act on payment
/tenant/sso: identity-provider configuration: security settings the assistant does not change
/admin/sso: identity-provider configuration across tenants: security settings the assistant does not change
/admin/system-settings: platform-wide settings, saved by a platform admin; the assistant does not change them
/commitments/new: a form: draft_need_card fills its fields from the conversation and the person reads the quality checks and presses Publish; publishing is never the assistant’s write
/c/[token]: public need card for people without an account, read before sign-in; the assistant is a signed-in feature
/u/[token]: a founder update its author made public, read without an account; the assistant is a signed-in feature
